_help: The home page. banners = the large slides at the top (after featured events and the next holiday). tiles = the smaller banners. highlights = what Chabad of Lamorinda has built. stats = big numbers, e.g. {"id": "families", "number": "300+", "label": "families"} (only real numbers from the Rabbi). A banner or tile can point at a program ("program": "hebrew-school") to use its name and summary, or have its own title and text. art = a picture name from site/assets/art; theme = navy, blue, green, gold or burgundy; image = /media/... photo.

banners.title: Shabbat at Chabad of Lamorinda
banners.text: Kabbalat Shabbat on Friday at {kabbalat-shabbat}, and Shabbat services on Saturday at 10 AM with a hot Kiddush lunch. Everyone is welcome, no membership needed.

tiles.title: Sponsor a Kiddush
tiles.text: Mark a birthday, anniversary or yahrzeit with the whole community at the Shabbat Kiddush.

highlights.title: Lamorinda Jewish Preschool
highlights.text: A warm Jewish start for the youngest children, directed by Rebbetzin Tzipora Labkowski.

highlights.title: Lamorinda Hebrew School
highlights.text: Hebrew reading, the holidays and Bar and Bat Mitzvah preparation for ages 3 to 13, every Sunday.

highlights.title: Shabbat every week
highlights.text: Services, a hot Kiddush lunch and Shabbat dinners with the Rabbi's family, for anyone who wants to come.

highlights.title: Bay Kosher
highlights.text: Kosher meat, groceries and Judaica delivered across the area, a project of Chabad of Lamorinda.

highlights.title: There in every moment
highlights.text: Hospital visits, weddings, funerals, shiva and private help for families, from beginning to end.

highlights.title: No membership, no dues
highlights.text: Every Jew belongs. The community is carried by partners who give monthly in the Chai Club.
